entries.text: moves in silent single-file herds at dusk
hoards polished bones arranged in spirals
follows travellers for days, always just out of sight
sings in eerie harmony with its kin before a storm
buries its kills and returns for them at the new moon
basks motionless on warm stone until touched
stalks lantern light, mistaking it for prey
trades shiny trinkets with anyone who leaves an offering
sleeps coiled around a hoard of rusted crowns
guards a single egg with total ferocity
migrates across the sky in vast slow spirals
decorates its lair with flowers stolen from graves
dances in rings beneath the full moon
rides the backs of larger beasts as a scavenger
patrols the same route every night, never late
plays dead, then strikes when someone kneels to look
tends the wounded of any species it finds
builds cairns of stacked stones along old roads
nests in the ribcages of fallen giants
hunts in pairs, one herding while the other waits
bows its head to anyone bearing a holy symbol
drinks only from still water under moonlight
sniffs out spent spells and feeds on the residue
gnaws on iron and leaves trails of red rust
sheds its skin into hollow decoys that fool hunters
collects the voices of the drowned and hums them back
